questions.answer: I took one class for final year students and 3 for second year students

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: There was a much higher level of connection between students and teachers where the teachers seemed to care about their students, where most teachers at UCPH are more focused on their research and like teaching is something they are forced to do. The classes at my host institution were also smaller which created a much more intimate learning environment
